name: front-doors-build
description: BUILD MODE (2026-09-08): construction todos for the THREE unified front doors. No underlying systems are built here — this is the todo list for construction. All branding stripped from the unified vision; every audited feature retained; mem20 is the substrate.
shard: TO-DO LISTS ONLY — underlying systems build starts after imagination response + per-door kickoff

doors.name: THE REAL ONE
build_todos: T1.1 derive door-1 spec from front-door-audit.json merge_directive + imagination output
T1.2 map every audited live entry point (openwebui, dashboard, office, interstice, tt3d-ui, kanban, mem20-dashboard) to a door-1 route

T1.3 map every planned feature door to a door-1 route (plugin workspace, agent control center, workflow canvas, prompt library MCP, channels, artifact KV, calendar/notes surfaces, arena, eval tasks, IAM admin, tool-policy console, model router, voice/TTS)
T1.4 decide door-1 topology: single SPA vs gatewayed ports vs reverse-proxy mesh — pick ONE authoritative base URL
T1.5 define door-1 auth: SSO/IAM (casdoor pattern) as the single sign-on for all surfaces
T1.6 stub door-1 shell (nav: office / forge / dashboard / tools / state / arena)
T1.7 stub door-1 routes serving EXISTING live surfaces (no rewrites yet)
T1.8 wire door-1 to mem20-as-substrate (all state read/write via mem20 surfaces)
T1.9 branding pass: strip all product names from door-1 chrome — neutral unified identity
T1.10 door-1 acceptance checklist vs audit (every live + planned feature reachable)

doors.name: OPENCODE GODMODE
build_todos: T2.1 define godmode contract: what 'full creative access' means (all opencode tooling, filesystem, services)
T2.2 map audited planned features to godmode surfaces (control center parity, canvas compile, eval tasks, local daemon, self-reset playground)
T2.3 stub godmode launcher/alias that enters the unified system with creative permissions
T2.4 route godmode through the SAME IAM/SSO as door 1 (no second auth island)
T2.5 grant godmode read/write on mem20 substrate surfaces (ledger/store/cog)
T2.6 define escalation boundary: creative vs destructive gates (tool-policy approvals)
T2.7 branding pass: neutral identity, no product names
T2.8 godmode acceptance: every feature reachable within an opencode session

doors.name: QUEST 3D V-WORLD
doors.role: immersive 3D entrance — agents visible as natives
build_todos: T3.1 derive door-3 spec from INTERSTICE visual guide + imagination output
T3.2 map audited live surfaces into the 3D world (agents as natives: profiles/gateway/dashboard/office/tt3d-ui)
T3.3 map planned features into the 3D world (channels as shared rooms, workflow canvas as spatial graph, arena as live colosseum, artifact KV as world objects)
T3.4 decide delivery: existing tt3d-nim-ui/office pipeline for Quest 3 (WebXR) — no new engine
T3.5 stub 3D world shell: spatial nav, agent-native rendering, room system
T3.6 wire world state to mem20 substrate (world facts = grounded ledger facts)
T3.7 branding pass: neutral unified identity in-world
T3.8 door-3 acceptance: agent presence, world-object surfaces, Quest 3 reachable

shared_foundation_todos: F1 produce ONE unified system model from imagination output (containment of all audited features)
F2 define unified identity + stripped branding tokens (no product names anywhere)
F3 adopt unified IAM/SSO as the single auth across all 3 doors
F4 standardize feature access matrix: which door exposes which live+planned feature
F5 keep all live services running during construction; doors reference, never replace
F6 single source of truth = mem20 substrate; every door reads/writes through it
next_step: await imagination response, then T1.1/T2.1/T3.1 derive specs and begin the shell todos
